Recto, column I (right side)

 

  1. In Thy Name, oh Merciful!
  2. The accounting of the (part) of the Estate that is inhabited for rent:
  3. The lane of the synagogue:
  4. (4-5) Al-Shaykh Abūʾl-Surūr, may God preserve him, 20. His nephew, al-Shaykh Abūʾl-Mufaḍḍal, may God preserve him, 13.
  5.  
  6. (6-7) Ṭāhir al-Qūṣī, may God preserve him, 5. Al-Shaykh Abūʾl-Baqā, may God preserve him, for the ruin, 5.
  7.  
  8. (8-9) The wife of b. Shālōm, 3. Al-Shaykh Maḥfūẓ, may God preserve him, for al-Burj, 10.
  9.  
  10. (10-11) Wafā al-Saqqā, may God preserve him, 2½. Wuhayb al-Raqqāṣ, two ṭabaqas, 12½.
  11.  
  12. (Total,) 71.
  13. The upper part of the funduq of the qōdesh:
  14. (14-15) Al-Shaykh Abūʾl-Munā, may God preserve him, 15. Abraham al-Ṣāʾigh, may God preserve him, 5.
  15.  
  16. (16-17) Asad, may God preserve him, 8. Al-Shaykh Abū Isḥaq al-Levi, may God preserve him, 7.
  17.  
  18. (Canceled: And in the funduq); (Total,) 35.
  19. (19-20) Opposite the funduq, the storeroom of wood that is the apartment of al-Daqqāq, 3. The foundry of al-Zajjāj, 3.
  20.  
  21. (21-23) Dār Sālim in the lane (of) Makīn, 10. Dār b. Pinḥās, the apartment of al-Shaykh Abū Sahl, may God preserve him, 10. Shirkat al-Qāḍī, 6.
  22.  
  23.  
  24. (24-25) The mustaraqa, the apartment of the woman, 2.
  25.  
  26. (Total,) 34.
  27. (Al-)Sūq al-Kabīr:
  28. (28-29) The funduq, 30. Its upper part, 7. The shop of al-Muʿallim, 1.
  29.  
  30. (Total,) 38.
